passiveEffects.name: Steelworker
passiveEffects.originalDescription: Dhelmise is granted a shield whenever one of the user's moves deals damage to Pokémon from the opposing team (5s cd). Each time this Ability or other effects grant the Pokémon a shield, the Pokémon's next basic attack deals increased damage. This effect can stack up to 3 times. When the shield granted by this ability expires after 3s, HP proportional to the amount of remaining shields is restored.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Seaweed Snare
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Has the user throw their anchor and ensnare a designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage and leaving the target unable to act for 0.45s. The user then charges at the target, dealing damage and leaving them unable to act for 0.45s. If other Pokémon from the opposing team are hit by the anchor or the charge, they take damage and are shoved for 0.7s. Applies a cleansable damage over time effect to Pokémon on the opposing team that deals damage on hit and every 0.5s up to 9 times, healing Dhelmise with each tick based on damage dealt. The duration of the DoT is refreshed with each hit of the Unite Move. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
